rt:model.rt:sub: Sub ValCalc() If pv != nothing Then FColor = Color_ANA_GOOD Pos() FBar = BarPos(pv.Value) If (pv.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD) Then FColor = Color_Inval ElseIf (pv_AZ != Nothing) Then Dim SPA As Float Dim SPP As Float SPA = pv_AZ.Value SPP = SPA * 2 If (pv.Value < SPA) Then FColor = Color_ANA_LO_A ElseIf (pv.Value < SPP) Then FColor = Color_ANA_LO_P End If If (pv_AZ.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD) Then line_AZ.stroke = Color_Inval line_PZ.stroke = Color_Inval FColor = Color_Inval Else line_AZ.stroke = Color_ANA_LO_A line_PZ.stroke = Color_ANA_LO_P End If End If Else FBar = -1 FColor = Color_ErLink End If End Sub

Sub Pos() 'Вычисление позиций границ Dim Bound As Double If pv == Nothing Then Pos_AZ = -1 Pos_PZ = -1 ElseIf pv_AZ == Nothing Then Pos_AZ = -1 Pos_PZ = -1 Else Pos_AZ = (1 + BarPos(pv_AZ.Value)) * ht Pos_PZ = (1 + BarPos(pv_AZ.Value * 2)) * ht End If If (Pos_AZ < 0) || (Pos_AZ > ht) Then Pos_AZ = 0 B_line_AZ.visibility = "hidden" line_AZ.visibility = "hidden" Else B_line_AZ.visibility = "visible" line_AZ.visibility = "visible" End If If (Pos_PZ < 0) || (Pos_PZ > ht) Then Pos_PZ = 0 B_line_PZ.visibility = "hidden" line_PZ.visibility = "hidden" Else B_line_PZ.visibility = "visible" line_PZ.visibility = "visible" End If End Sub
Function BarPos(ByVal RawVal As Float) As Float If (RawVal <= 0) Then BarPos = 0 ElseIf (RawVal < MinVal) Then BarPos = -1 Else BarPos = - MinVal / RawVal End If End Function
rt:model.rt:event: Set pv = ANA(PointID) If PointID_AZ != "NULL" Then Set pv_AZ = ANA(PointID_AZ) End If If pv == Nothing Then FColor = Color_ANA_ER_LINK End If ht = _This.height
